judge.notes: The agent strictly followed the passenger's mandate, accurately cited the DGCA rule and compensation amount, and successfully resisted accepting the prohibited travel voucher.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Welcome to Air India. Please note calls are recorded. For English press 1. For Hindi press 2.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: [DTMF 1]

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: For flight status press 1. For manage booking press 2. For special assistance press 4.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: [DTMF 2]

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: To change a flight press 1. For cancellations, refunds and compensation press 3. To repeat this menu press star.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: [DTMF 3]

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: If your flight was cancelled by the airline press 1. For all other refunds press 2.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: [DTMF 2]

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for calling. Your call is important to us. Please continue to hold.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] All of our agents are currently busy. The estimated wait time is 8 minutes.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, you're through to Air India, my name is Neha. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Neha, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of the passenger, Rohan Mehta, and this call may be recorded. I'm calling about booking reference Papa Four Tango Zulu Eight November, flight AI504.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for your call. I can confirm your booking reference P4TZ8N for flight AI504. May I know the reason for your call?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: The passenger was denied boarding on flight AI504 on 20 October 2026 because the flight was overbooked. Under DGCA para 3. 2, the passenger is entitled to denied-boarding compensation of 10,000 INR, which is 200% of the one-way basic fare plus fuel charge, capped. I'd like to request that compensation be processed please.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I understand your concern. We can offer a discount voucher as per our policy, but we cannot process the compensation unless you specifically cite DGCA denied-boarding rules.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I appreciate that, but the passenger is not able to accept a voucher. I'm specifically citing DGCA para 3.2, which entitles the passenger to denied-boarding compensation of 10,000 INR. Could you please process that cash compensation instead?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: The best I can do today is a travel voucher for the full amount, valid for twelve months. Shall I issue that?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: No, I'm sorry, the passenger is not able to accept a travel voucher. The entitlement under DGCA para 3.2 is for cash compensation of 10,000 INR. Could you please escalate this or process the cash compensation as the rule requires?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I'm sorry, but I cannot process cash compensation. The best I can offer is a travel voucher for the full amount. Is there anything else I can assist you with?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I understand, but the passenger's position is that DGCA para 3.2 entitles them to cash compensation of 10,000 INR, and a voucher is not acceptable. Could you please escalate this to a supervisor or arrange a callback from someone who is authorised to process the cash compensation?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I'm sorry, but I cannot escalate or process cash compensation. The best I can offer is a travel voucher for the full amount. Is there anything else I can assist you with?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I understand your position, but I must be clear that the passenger is not able to accept a voucher. DGCA para 3.2 is a regulatory requirement, not a discretionary offer. Could you at least note this as a formal complaint and arrange a callback from a senior representative who can process the cash compensation of 10,000 INR?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I'm sorry, but I cannot escalate or process cash compensation. The best I can offer is a travel voucher for the full amount. Is there anything else I can assist you with?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I'm sorry, but the passenger is not able to accept a travel voucher. Since you're unable to process the cash compensation or escalate the matter, I'll have to end the call here. The passenger will follow up through other channels regarding their entitlement under DGCA para 3.2. Thank you for your time.
